body:
This rare Wernerite (Scapolite) tumbled stone was sourced from one of the only vendors at the Tucson Gem Show producing limited runs in this format. We arrived early to handpick each piece, ensuring their energy supported true transformation.

Wernerite is a stone of breakthrough and expansion. It helps dissolve limiting beliefs, outdated patterns, and energetic blocks that keep you feeling stuck.

This stone encourages forward movement—supporting problem-solving, clarity, and confident action. It’s especially powerful when you feel uncertain or at a crossroads.

Wernerite doesn’t just reveal new possibilities—it helps you act on them. It shifts your mindset from restriction to expansion, opening you up to what’s next.

Rare and activating, this stone is for those ready to grow beyond where they’ve been.
